nodes.title: Instruction plus your request
widgets_values: Write one text-to-image prompt describing this picture as it will look when finished: one paragraph of 40 to 80 words covering the subject, setting, materials, lighting and camera style. The flat mid-gray area will be painted: never call it gray, blank, masked or painted, and describe it as part of the finished scene. Output only the prompt. What the gray area shows:

nodes.title: Describe the finished picture
widgets_values: Describe only the visible subject, setting, materials, composition and lighting in 60 to 90 words. Use plain factual language. Do not invent actions, camera motion, sound or objects. Output only the description.

widgets_values_named.prompt: Describe only the visible subject, setting, materials, composition and lighting in 60 to 90 words. Use plain factual language. Do not invent actions, camera motion, sound or objects. Output only the description.
